# MultiFPGA_Spiking_Scaling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for scaling spiking neural networks across multiple FPGAs by partitioning the network and managing inter-FPGA spike communication. Enables larger SNN models than a single FPGA can support, addressing a key scalability bottleneck in neuromorphic hardware.
